item.title: Duty first
item.description: This is a dream, a small fraction of vacation for your soul. And it’s not free, and it’s not forever. That’s why you need to enjoy it as much as you can and stop overworrying in meaningless things. Deep, very deep in your soul you know it, and when you start to experience some kind of discomfort and hard situations in life is when you start remembering that you are actually doing well.
